note: Reminder titles, descriptions, comments and the source excerpt that caused a write. These leave the device for the State server the owner operates. The optional shared relay receives this content only as an encrypted package it cannot read.
Actor identifier, device label and the opaque relay route used to address encrypted notifications. The relay stores the APNs token encrypted at rest.
Owner display name and device name are free text the owner enters during pairing so the audit history can attribute every change.
